passive.description:
ALL ALLIES:
● Grants [Magic DMG Boost] (always active)

SELF:
● Grants [All DMG Nullification] for 3 hits
● [Revives] with 80% HP upon falling in battle (once per battle)
● Grants [Conqueror of Adversity] (always active)
● Grants [Effect Resist Boost] (always active)
● Grants 1 [Level Up] upon using a basic attack 2 times (Max 30 Levels)
● Grants 1 [Level Up] upon using a skill 1 time (Max 30 Levels)
● Grants 2 [Level Up] when an enemy falls in battle (Max 30 Levels)
enhancements:
● Increases Effect: [Magic DMG Boost] from 17% > 20%
● Increases Effect: [Revives] with 80% > 100% HP
● Increases Effect: [Effect Resist Boost] from 40% > 49%
transcendence: Increases Effect to SELF: [Level Up] Max count from 30 > 40

basicAttack.description:
1 ENEMY:
● Deals DMG equal to 100% of MATK
● Deals additional DMG equal to 45% of MATK against targets with [Defense Boost]

skill1.description:
4 ENEMIES:
● Deals [Piercing] DMG equal to 57% of MATK plus 7% of the target's MAX HP 2 times (HP-based DMG limited to 75% of caster's ATK)
enhancements: ●  Increases DMG: 57% > 67% of MATK plus 7% > 9% of target's MAX HP

skill2.description:
ALL ENEMIES:
● Deals [DEF-Ignoring] DMG equal to 45% of MATK 2 times
● Each attack deals additional [DEF-Ignoring] DMG equal to 62% of MATK when the target's SPD is lower than the caster's SPD

passive: Magic DMG Boost: Increases MDMG dealt by 17%
All DMG Nullification: Nullifies all DMG for a set amount of hits
Conqueror of Adversity (Stacks): DMG increases by 2% in proportion to the current stage level
Effect Resist Boost: Increases Effect Resistance by 40%
Level Up (Stacks): Increases All ATK by 3%. The total amount of enhancement levels is retained when the target falls
